name: document
doc: A document: a file with a title, such as a scanned invoice, a certificate or a photo.

texts.label: Document
texts.help: A file with a title, such as a scanned invoice, a certificate or a photo.

help_translations.de: Eine Datei mit Titel, etwa eine eingescannte Rechnung, eine Bescheinigung oder ein Foto.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the document is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the document is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Was das Dokument ist, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: file_name
fields.doc: The file's name with its extension, such as invoice-2026-11.pdf. Empty when not known.

texts.label: File name
texts.help: The file's name with its extension, such as invoice-2026-11.pdf.

help_translations.de: Der Name der Datei mit Endung, etwa invoice-2026-11.pdf.

fields.name: media_type
fields.doc: The media type of content as in RFC 6838, such as application/pdf or image/jpeg, without parameters.

texts.label: File type
texts.help: The media type of the file, such as application/pdf.

help_translations.de: Der Medientyp der Datei, etwa application/pdf.

fields.name: content
fields.doc: The file's content. The whole message, this record included, must stay within the message limit of the AXT envelope.

fields.name: dated
fields.doc: The date the document bears, such as the date of an invoice, or only its month or year where it names no day. Null when it bears none.

texts.label: Date
texts.help: The date the document bears, such as the date of an invoice.

help_translations.de: Das Datum, das das Dokument trägt, etwa das Datum einer Rechnung.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the document, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.
